assertions.title: Setup changes reshape what Sites offers and what staff booking warns about, consistently

steps.action: Step 1 baseline: Sites /reserve party 2 on 2026-11-23 shows time chips; public availability API returns slots
steps.observed: Sites rendered 36 chips (Weekend Brunch 10:00-13:45, R2-API-Service 17:00-21:30, Dinner 21:45); GET /reservations/availability p2 -> 200, 36 slots, dayVersion 1, ETag "1.68.11"; p4 -> 34 slots; operator availability p2/p4 -> 141 slots each (19 dinner). Console errors: none.

steps.action: Step 2: add online_closed special day for 2026-11-23 via App Settings, Special days (UI); reload /reserve; check API; create a phone booking in App Book
steps.expected: Sites shows no online slots (closed note); API returns online_closed/empty; staff booking succeeds
steps.observed: API: status online_closed, 0 slots, onlineClosed{name,note} (200). Staff booking on the day: App sheet showed 32 slots + 'Closed for online bookings on this date. Staff can still book.' and POST /operator/reservations/book/reservations -> 201, warnings []. BUT the Sites page served STALE availability: after the change, the page's own fetch (browser default cache mode) returned the cached pre-change body (36 slots, exactly the step-1 baseline) and the UI still rendered chips; a cache-bypassing fetch (cache:'reload'/'no-store') returned online_closed/0 and the page then showed 'Online booking is closed for this date.' Root cause: the first mutation of a previously-untouched day does not change the public ETag (readDayVersion defaults to 1 when no rsv_day_versions row exists, rsv-public-engine.ts:438-454; the first write inserts version 1, rsv-setup-crud.ts:111-132), so a client holding ETag "1.68.11" revalidates and gets 304 Not Modified with the stale body (reproduced with curl If-None-Match -> 304). This is the contract's explicit fail condition 'any channel sees stale availability'.

steps.action: Step 3: change the special day to closed; check Sites, the API and a staff booking (sheet + curl without/with override)
steps.expected: Sites closed note; API closed; staff booking fails or blocks with the closed reason
steps.observed: Sites: 'The restaurant is closed on this date.' + note (fresh fetch; ETag changed to "3.68.11" because this was the second mutation). API: status closed, 0 slots, closed{reason:'special_day',name,note}. App sheet: booking-closed-day alert 'Closed on this date (R2B-OnlineClosed). No slots are offered. Turn on the override below to book anyway.', 0 slots, submit disabled. curl staff booking without override -> 409 closed_day ('overbook override required'). Ticking 'Override closed day' -> POST 201 with warnings [{code:'closed_day'}]. Round-1 step-3 failure is fixed.

steps.action: Step 4: dinner-only replace-day fixture (UI special day) + service availability (all 11 areas staff_only, T1 patio online, T4 patio online); then mark T4 staff_only

After T4 -> staff_only: public p4 -> 0 slots, status full (Sites: 'No tables available for that search'); public p2 -> 18 slots unchanged (Sites still lists 5:30 PM onward); operator p4 -> 19 slots, all available. sqlite row sa_9c23a31a mode online -> staff_only; PUT 200.

steps.action: Step 5: pacing rule max_parties=1 / 15-min bucket / channel=all for the fixture dinner service; one existing booking in the 19:00 bucket; re-query both channels; staff booking without and with explicit overbook; App sheet path
steps.expected: Sites omits the bucket; staff availability shows the same-bucket slot with a pacing warning; staff may proceed with explicit overbook; no silent success
steps.observed: Rule pac_fd22af5c created (maxCovers 30, maxParties 1, bucket 15, channel all). One booking for the fixture service at 19:00 (T4) created with explicit overbook -> 201 + warnings [{code:'pacing_parties_exceeded'}]. Public: 19:00 ABSENT while 18:45 and 19:15 present (bucket omitted). Operator availability for the fixture service: 19:00 slot available=true, pacingWarning=false - the pre-submit warning flag is still missing for a max_parties-only rule (round-1 defect persists; rsv-day-feed-service.ts:1500-1504 evaluates only maxCovers). Turn on the pacing override to book anyway.'; ticking 'Override slot pacing cap' -> 201 with overbook:true and warnings [{code:'pacing_parties_exceeded'}] and a toast 'Booked over the pacing party limit.'. Staff channel is warned (409 + warnings array + toast), so per the parent's criterion this step is not a silent success; the literal contract clause 'staff availability shows the next same-bucket slot with a pacing warning' is still not met by the availability payload.

assertions.issues: Step 2 fails the contract's explicit fail condition 'any channel sees stale availability'. The Sites guest channel kept offering the pre-change 36 slots after the online_closed special day was added, because the first mutation of a previously-untouched business date does not change the public availability ETag: readDayVersion (apps/tenant-api/src/services/rsv-public-engine.ts:438-454) returns `row?.version ?? 1` and the first write inserts `version: 1` (apps/tenant-api/src/services/rsv-setup-crud.ts:111-132 / rsv-day-feed-service.ts:119-141), so ETag "1.68.11" before == after. A client with the pre-change body revalidates with If-None-Match and gets 304 (reproduced with curl), so the Sites page's own fetch (apps/sites/src/lib/reservations/api.ts send(): default fetch cache mode) served the stale 36-slot body while the calendar API was already fresh; a cache-bypassing fetch showed the correct closed note. Second and later mutations do change the ETag (step 3's Sites check was correct with a warm cache), so this affects exactly the first setup change on a date that had no prior day-version row. Same root cause also breaks the VAL-ONLINE-002 clause 'after any booking ... returns 200 with a new ETag' for a first booking on a fresh date (not tested here, out of scope). Additionally, the round-1 step-5 defect persists in the availability read: GET /operator/reservations/book/availability returns available=true, pacingWarning=false for a max_parties=1 breach (rsv-day-feed-service.ts:1500-1504 evaluates only rule.maxCovers), so the App sheet shows the breached slot as normal and only errors on submit; the staff channel is still warned (409, and 201 + warnings [{code:'pacing_parties_exceeded'}] + toast when the override is used), which satisfies the parent's 'staff channel warned / no silent success' criterion but not the literal 'slot with a pacing warning' clause. Steps 3 (closed day blocks staff, override warns) and 4 (staff_only 4-top removes public p4 while staff keeps p4) now pass.

summary: VAL-CROSS-007 re-tested on 2026-11-23 with agent-browser (App + Sites), curl and read-only sqlite. Steps 1, 3 and 4 pass; the round-1 failures are fixed: a closed day now blocks staff booking with the closed reason (sheet alert + disabled submit, 409 closed_day without override, 201 with a closed_day warning on the explicit override) and a staff_only 4-top removes public party-4 slots (17 -> 0) while party 2 keeps slots and staff availability still offers party 4 (19 slots). Step 5's pacing rule hides the bucket from Sites (19:00 absent, neighbours present) and the staff channel is warned at submit time (409 pacing_parties_exceeded; 201 + warnings array + toast 'Booked over the pacing party limit.' on the explicit override), but the availability payload still reports available=true/pacingWarning=false for the max_parties breach - the round-1 availability defect persists (rsv-day-feed-service.ts:1500-1504). Step 2 fails the contract's explicit fail condition 'any channel sees stale availability': after the online_closed special day was added, the Sites page served the pre-change 36 slots from its HTTP cache because the first mutation of a previously-untouched day leaves the public ETag unchanged (dayVersion default 1 vs first insert 1); a cache-bypassing fetch and curl If-None-Match -> 304 confirm the mechanism, and the API/UI are correct once the cache is bypassed. Verdict: fail (step 2 stale guest availability), with the round-1 fix targets for steps 3 and 5 confirmed working; all fixture state restored.
